To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
there is a positive effect of past internationalization on process innovation and a positive effect of the past process innovation on the internationalization of non-micro firms in Viet Nam.

(1) process innovation and internationalization are persistent, and (2) process innovation is positively associated with the internationalization decision, but internationalization is not associated with product innovation.

process innovation and internationalization are persistent decisions, that past internationalization increases the probability of future process innovation, that past process innovation does increase the probability of future internationalization for non-micro enterprises, that past international innovation does not affect the probability of future product innovation, and that past product innovation does not affect future internationalization.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamic relationship between innovation and international activities of firms.

the dynamic relationship between internationalization and innovation, and it contributes to the literature by providing new evidence on the relationship between innovation and international business activities of small and medium enterprises in developing countries.
a dynamic bivariate model of the innovation and internationalization decisions of small and medium-size firms in developing countries.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dynamics between process innovation and internationalization are complex and depend on the firm size.
the internationalization decision and innovation are not mutually reinforcing.
internationalization and innovation in Viet Nam are interlinked, but the nature of the relationship is complex and depends on the type of innovation and the size of the firm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the internationalization of firms in Viet Nam has been a dynamic process and that the internationalization decision and process innovation have a dynamic relationship, but the internationalization decision has not been affected by the product innovation decision.
internationalization has a strong positive impact on the innovation process, but innovation has a weak effect on internationalization.
the innovation and internationalization of small and medium-size enterprises in Viet Nam are not mutually exclusive, but they do not reinforce each other.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in developing countries like Viet Nam, innovation is an important driver of the internationalization decision for non-micro enterprises.
the relationship between innovation and international activities of firms is complex and that the direction of causality depends on the type of innovation and the type of firm.
the dynamics of innovation and internationalization are different for micro firms and non-micro firms.
